description: HTML to Markdown as you type: paste HTML, get clean Markdown with the rendered result beside it. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

bullet.description: The character unordered list items start with. Defaults to '-'.

headingStyle.description: 'atx' (the default) writes '# Title'. 'setext' underlines level 1 and 2 headings with === and ---; deeper levels stay '###'.

html.description: The HTML to convert: a fragment or a whole page (only the <body> is converted). Headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, images, nested and task lists, code blocks with their language, blockquotes, tables and rules become GitHub-flavoured Markdown. Scripts and styles are removed; other tags are reduced to their text.

keepHtml.description: Keep elements Markdown has no syntax for (u, sub, sup, mark, kbd, iframe, video and similar) as inline HTML in the output. Off by default: they are reduced to their text. Layout tags like div and span are unwrapped either way.

name: html_to_markdown
title: HTML to Markdown
